positions.notes: {{SQ:T14,T15,T16,S15|The pyramid}}. {{CR:T15|The center point}} touches the other three.

extra.XSUM: Four points in a T shape. The point touching the other three is the vital point: whoever plays it decides the result.
extra.XSRC: Sensei's Library (senseis.xmp.net): KillableEyeshapes and the shape's own page. Results checked with a small life-and-death search.
